propositions: Mutating CLI verbs (link, unlink, comment, tag, edit, set-file-impact, etc.) return exit 0 with empty stdout on success, making successful writes indistinguishable from idempotent no-ops, forcing agents to run secondary show commands to verify mutations.

All mutating verbs in _WRITES_FULL and _LIFECYCLE must emit a single-line kubectl-style confirmation (`<past-tense-verb> <args-summary>`) on successful write and `no change: <reason>` on idempotent no-op, building output only from CLI args and seam outcome without follow-up store reads.
Already-printing verbs (create, idea, revert, claim, session-log, transition, reopen) must be normalized to the shared confirmation contract while preserving every datum currently printed.

Global --quiet/-q and --output/-o flags must be extracted at the top-level router before verb dispatch to work uniformly on all in-scope verbs including positional-only _REGISTRY leaves, with quiet suppressing confirmations only and --output json wrapping the outcome in a structured envelope.
The link verb's existing REDIRECT record emission must remain byte-identical before and after the change on both write and no-op paths, including under --quiet, printing exactly one result to stdout.

Confirmations must print to stdout only in text mode; under --output json the outcome rides as a structured field, and existing seam return contracts (e.g., add_dependency's dict | None) must remain unchanged.
